Get the root directory of a backend

Source: R/backend-defaults.R
backend_root_dir.Rd

Returns the root (data directory) that condathis assigns to a backend. The root of the built-in "micromamba" backend is the condathis data directory (see get_install_dir()). The root of every other backend is the directory of its name inside it, for example <condathis data directory>/rattler. A backend keeps its environments in <root>/envs, and its caches in other directories of its root (see Roots in register_backend()). The default functions of the backend contract use this directory, and a backend package calls it to find its root.

Usage

backend_root_dir(name)

Arguments

name

Character string, a backend name, registered or not. It follows the rules of name in register_backend(), except that "micromamba" is allowed.

Value

An fs_path, the absolute path of the root. When the root exists, its real path (symbolic links resolved). Otherwise, the real path of its nearest existing parent directory, followed by the rest of the path. It creates nothing. Aborts with class condathis_backend_invalid_name for a malformed name, and condathis_backend_reserved_name (also condathis_backend_invalid_name) for a reserved name other than "micromamba".

Details

backend_root_dir() computes the path on every call, so it follows with_sandbox_dir().

Part of the experimental backend extension API. See the Lifecycle section of register_backend().

See also

get_install_dir()

Other backends: list_registered_backend_names(), register_backend(), unregister_backend()

Examples

condathis::with_sandbox_dir({
  condathis::backend_root_dir("rattler")
  #> <data dir>/R/condathis/rattler
})
#> /tmp/RtmpxiirNk/condathis-sandbox-2b1e660ac600/data/R/condathis/rattler
